comment: Liquid Dynamics liquids. Units are in the field names. Properties at 20 C unless noted. Colours are linear RGB for rendering only.

liquids.name: Red wine
liquids.description: A dry red at about 13% alcohol: a little lighter than water, a third less surface tension, half again as viscous.

provenance.density_kgm3: published: dry red wines 990-996 kg/m3 at 20 C (OIV Compendium of International Methods, density and specific gravity)
provenance.surface_tension_mNm: published: 12-14% v/v ethanol in water, 46-49 mN/m at 20 C (Vazquez, Alvarez & Navaza, J. Chem. Eng. Data 40 (1995) 611)
provenance.viscosity_mPas: published: 12-14% v/v ethanol-water 1.5-1.7 mPa s at 20 C (Khattab et al., J. Mol. Liq. 2012); wine solids add a little
provenance.stain_color: gameplay: rendering colour of a dried red wine stain

liquids.name: White wine
liquids.description: A dry white: the same physics as the red, a pale straw colour.

provenance.density_kgm3: published: dry white wines 988-994 kg/m3 at 20 C (OIV Compendium)
provenance.surface_tension_mNm: published: 12% v/v ethanol in water ~47 mN/m (Vazquez et al. 1995)
provenance.viscosity_mPas: published: 12% v/v ethanol-water ~1.5 mPa s at 20 C

liquids.name: Water
liquids.description: Pure water at 20 C, the reference liquid of the validation cases.

provenance.density_kgm3: published: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 998.21 kg/m3 at 20 C
provenance.surface_tension_mNm: published: IAPWS (2014) release on the surface tension of ordinary water, 72.74 mN/m at 20 C
provenance.viscosity_mPas: published: CRC Handbook, 1.0016 mPa s at 20 C
provenance.stain_color: gameplay: rendering colour of a wet mark

liquids.name: Olive oil
liquids.description: Eighty times as viscous as water: it pours in a rope and barely splashes.

provenance.density_kgm3: published: olive oil 910-916 kg/m3 at 20 C (Codex Alimentarius CXS 33-1981)
provenance.surface_tension_mNm: published: olive oil ~32 mN/m at 20 C (Sahasrabudhe et al., J. Am. Oil Chem. Soc. 2017)
provenance.viscosity_mPas: published: olive oil ~84 mPa s at 20 C (Kim et al., Int. J. Food Prop. 2010)

liquids.name: Green stage blood
liquids.description: Stage blood dyed green to keep it G-rated, with the density, surface tension and shear-thinning of whole human blood, so its spatter flies and stains like the real thing.

provenance.density_kgm3: published: whole blood 1050-1065 kg/m3 (Kenner, Basic Res. Cardiol. 84 (1989) 111)
provenance.surface_tension_mNm: published: whole blood ~56 mN/m at 37 C (Hrncir & Rosina, Physiol. Res. 46 (1997) 319)
provenance.mu0_mPas: published: Carreau fit to whole blood, mu0 = 56 mPa s (Cho & Kensey, Biorheology 28 (1991) 241)
provenance.mu_inf_mPas: published: Carreau fit, mu_inf = 3.45 mPa s (Cho & Kensey 1991)
provenance.lambda_s: published: Carreau fit, lambda = 3.313 s (Cho & Kensey 1991)
provenance.color: gameplay: green dye for a G rating
provenance.stain_color: gameplay: rendering colour of a dried stain
